caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture resembling a chest or box with a fitted lid, positioned on a stand. The chest is rectangular with dovetail joinery visible at the vertical corners, and the wood has a reddish-brown tone with distinct grain patterns. The lid is flat and slightly overhangs the edges of the chest. The chest sits on a base composed of four turned wooden legs connected by four horizontal stretchers forming a rectangle, with the tops of each leg extending vertically past the base to flank the sides of the chest. The legs have small, spherical feet at the corners of the stand. The background is plain and light in color, and there is a small inscription reading "William H. Edwards, Del. 399-l." near the bottom right of the image.
title: Dough Bin
